verdict.rationale: Openness of source code is a fair question for a cloud platform, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence that Google Cloud's own platform source is published under an open license. The only open-source item is a separate ancillary tool, MCP Toolbox for Databases, which is at most adjacent and does not show the product's source is readable under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
